Lauren — thanks for the packet and clear next steps. A couple quick items from our side to keep the procurement/finance flow tidy: 

1) PO mapping: please use PO# RDW-PO-7894 on all invoices to ensure automated routing into our AP system.
2) Vendor form: we've sent a vendor enrollment link via DocuSign for completion of tax and compliance fields (should arrive in the next hour).
3) Micro-deposit confirmation: Marissa (cc) will verify and reply once the two micro-deposit amounts hit our remittance tracking.

Two asks for you: can you confirm whether the virtual IBAN will accept invoice-level remittance references (e.g., invoice number in reference field) and whether the remit email supports machine-readable remittance (CSV or XML)? That will determine the mapping we set on our payment rails.

Once the micro-deposits are confirmed, Marissa will request the activation certificate if you have one; otherwise we can mark the vendor active after we receive the DocuSign form + micro-deposit verification.

Thanks — Priya
